definitions.explanation: Japan's most widely used smartphone payment service, launched in 2018, in which the customer pays by scanning or showing a QR code or barcode. Usually written PayPay; ペイペイ is how it is said.

examples.japanese: ペイペイ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{払|はら}えます→払う：00535_harau⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{現金|げんきん}→現金：02716_genkin⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ペイペイしか⟦{使|つか}えない→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: This shop only takes cash and PayPay.

examples.japanese: ⟦{割|わ}り{勘|かん}→割り勘：08156_warikan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧とき、ペイペイ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦お{金|かね}→お金：00611_okane⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{便利|べんり}→便利：00830_benri⟧だ。
examples.english: When splitting the bill, it's handy to send your share to a friend by PayPay.

notes:
USAGE:
Used with で: ペイペイ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧ (pay by PayPay), ペイペイ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧ (send money by PayPay). Shops show a sticker or a QR stand at the register.
